name: plugin-security-scan
description: Scans internally-built Claude/Cowork plugins for security flaws: static code analysis (SAST), vulnerable/risky third-party libraries (with OSSF Scorecard maintenance-hygiene checks), sensitive data or secrets leakage (with TruffleHog verified-credential detection), prompt-injection/instruction-safety risks, and build-time context leakage. Logs every scan to a shared Google Drive record that tracks history and trends.
